surfaces.label: Buyer/custody settlement and beneficiary-bound claims
surfaces.notes: Independent baseline and focused investigator both found no ordinary-buyer asset theft, duplicate settlement or early-claim path for the configured nominal-transfer ULIQ token. Presale:336-424; custody:96-132,186-194; vesting:84-139. Parent added and ran deterministic real-custody rollback, blocked-recipient, deadline and repeated-claim tests: 7/7 passed including one operational-defect reproduction. Follow-up: expanded regression suite 13/13 passed; actual Round 1 and Round 2 payout paths pass after READY-expiry recovery.

surfaces.label: Legacy ULIQ locker
surfaces.notes: ULIQLocker.sol:52-94 checks owner, maturity, one withdrawal, increasing extension. ULIQToken.sol:12-23 uses nominal ERC20 transfers; fee-token insolvency is not applicable to intended ULIQ. This legacy implementation has no Mainnet deployment decision.

candidate.attacker: No unprivileged attacker forcing the owner to miss activation was demonstrated.
candidate.counterevidence: Timely activation avoids defect; DRAFT permits schedule repair; ACTIVE/PAUSED can end after expiry. This is a confirmed operational lifecycle defect, not privilege escalation.
candidate.evidence: activateSale requires block.timestamp < saleEnd, endSale accepts only ACTIVE/PAUSED, configureSaleWindow is DRAFT-only, releaseUnsold requires ended state. Round 2 expiry after Round 1 finalization prevents both-round listing readiness.
candidate.remediation: Define and implement expired READY-to-ENDED transition for zero-purchase rounds; preserve immutable-source return and both-round listing guards; test prior finalized round claims. Implemented locally in the authorized follow-up; see remediation evidence and corrected-source SHA-256 in scan scope.
candidate.title: Expired READY round cannot end, trapping inventory and the shared listing
candidate.validation: Reproduced in ULIQAuditRegressionTest.testAuditReproducesExpiredReadyRoundBlockingEarlierVesting with real ULIQPaymentCustody. READY Round 2 cannot activate/end/reschedule/release; 100 million ULIQ stays in it and finalized Round 1 vesting remains zero-claimable while USDC is already at treasury.

surfaces.label: R-01: expired READY round blocks inventory return and shared vesting
surfaces.notes: Original revision: Confirmed operational defect, MEDIUM severity and Mainnet blocker; not rejected as a code defect. Rejected only as an adversarial/privilege-gain finding because no unprivileged actor forcing the owner to miss activation was established. Source ULIQPresaleRound.sol:197-205,225-243,260-269,295-309; listing:32-54; vesting:121-123. Real-custody reproduction passes, asserting 100,000,000 ULIQ stranded in READY Round 2 and 250,000 finalized Round 1 ULIQ unclaimable after 500 USDC reached treasury. Correct by safely ending expired zero-purchase READY rounds; validate actual earlier-round claim and exact inventory return. Tracked as R-01 in packages/contracts/ULIQ_PRESALE_VESTING_LOCKING_REVIEW.md. Follow-up status 2026-09-07: fixed locally, not deployed. Existing endSale accepts READY only at or after saleEnd; markReady rejects expired windows. Early-end, pending settlement, both-round listing and immutable inventory-source guards remain. The former reproduction was replaced by successful beneficiary-payout recovery tests, with successor activation, exact one-time inventory return, deadline fuzzing and unchanged ABI/storage verified. Expanded regression suite: 7 passed/6 failed before fix, 13 passed afterward.

surfaces.label: Caps, quotes, withdrawal capacity restoration and inventory source
surfaces.notes: PresaleRound.sol:159-220,295-333,360-400 enforces economics, exact one-time source funding, cap/wallet limits and single immutable-source unsold return. Unit/fuzz/invariant tests pass. Rounding cannot increase principal; donations remain separate. Source does not mint.

surfaces.label: One-time graph binding and privileged availability
surfaces.notes: No outsider graph substitution demonstrated. Listing.sol:32-41 and Vesting.sol:75-81 rely on trusted owner wiring, with narrower validation than Custody.sol:85-93. Round.sol:225-232 does not validate custody back-reference. Round/listing/vesting inherit Ownable.renounceOwnership; custody:168-170 forbids it. Wrong wiring, renunciation or never scheduling listing can block funds; explicit pre-value requirements remain, not new attacker capabilities.

surfaces.label: Cancellation, USDC issuer availability and direct-call access
surfaces.notes: Round.sol:382-424 permits refund only while pending and within deadline; finalization releases proceeds before listing; Vesting.sol:99-139 supplies no timeout/cancellation exit. ADR-001 cancellation/safeguarding requirements remain unresolved. Buyer refund rejection did not block treasury finalization in deterministic test. Treasury/custody issuer restrictions and USDC pause are external availability assumptions, not buyer callbacks. buy has no backend attestation/terms gate; current accepted model requires Legal approval.
